units.title: Measurement uncertainty and propagation through an inference

required_components.description: Specify the measurand and measurement equation; distinguish error, correction and uncertainty.
required_components.success_condition: Give an explicit quantity, units, input roles and uncertain corrections.
required_components.failure_condition: Treat uncertainty as an observed error or the standard deviation as every source of uncertainty.

required_components.description: Derive covariance propagation and state the first-order boundary.
required_components.success_condition: Derive u²(y)=JΣJᵀ under its approximation conditions and retain covariance terms.
required_components.failure_condition: Use the independent-input formula for shared calibration errors or declare the Taylor approximation exact.

required_components.description: Separate Type A/Type B evaluations from random/systematic error terminology.
required_components.success_condition: Explain each information source and attach its uncertainty evaluation to the same model.
required_components.failure_condition: Call Type B subjective error without an assigned information model or equate the two classifications.

required_components.description: Explain coverage factors and nonlinear failure.
required_components.success_condition: Show why a quoted coverage factor needs conditions and supply a nonlinear countercase.
required_components.failure_condition: Treat k=2 as universally exact 95% coverage or ignore a zero-gradient failure.

units.title: Global sensitivity and robustness of model-based inference

required_components.description: Separate uncertainty propagation, local derivatives and global sensitivity.
required_components.success_condition: Answer output spread and source-of-variation questions separately.
required_components.failure_condition: Call a local derivative a complete global uncertainty analysis.

required_components.description: Reconstruct the OAT counterargument and appropriate alternatives.

required_components.description: Define first-order and total variance-based indices.
required_components.success_condition: Derive selected indices from conditional expectation and variance with correct assumptions.
required_components.failure_condition: Ignore dependence or confuse sensitivity with causal effect.

required_components.description: Test the sensitivity of the substantive conclusion.
